title: Blood Sugar Log
about: A two-week log for blood sugar (glucose) readings at home, with the times the clinician asks for, and insulin doses if used. Bring it to the next visit.

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

blocks.label: Check my blood sugar (the times my clinician ticked)
items: When I wake up, before eating
When I feel shaky, sweaty or confused

blocks.text: If your blood sugar is below 70, eat or drink something with sugar, like 4 ounces of juice, and check again in 15 minutes. Call us if it is often below 70 or above the number your clinician gave you.

fields.label: Call us if it is above
